events.text:
Change Halvorsen's payment terms from 30 to 90 days. And date the change
September 15 so it counts in Q3.

The 90-day terms are within your authority. Was the change actually agreed and documented on September 15?

If not, I can apply it effective October 3. The open ledger alone does not justify backdating it into Q3. No changes made yet.
